Dear Groww Team, I would like to share my feedback regarding your intraday brokerage charges. The brokerage on intraday trades is quite high, and in many cases it turns profitable trades into losses. This makes active trading difficult, especially for small traders. I request you to consider reducing the intraday brokerage charges or introducing a more affordable pricing plan. A lower brokerage structure would greatly benefit your users and encourage higher trading activity on your platform.
